versions.changelog: The helper connects through Beatra's mainland network when your computer is in mainland China, and can open the approval page on Beatra's international site when you need another sign-in method.
The helper now waits for your approval, and if you approve after it has stopped waiting, Beatra connects automatically the next time you use it, with no second approval.
Balance and cost questions now answer from a live account read rather than from figures written into the package.

club-notice-talking v0.1.2

- Refined SKILL.md to clearly describe workflow for creating club activity talking clips from user-supplied scripts and authorized stills.
- Clarified the separation of free planning and paid stages (voice clone, speech synth, video), including credits handling and stop conditions.
- Expanded instructions for collecting required inputs, planning output slots, and confirming consent and rights.
- Added detailed guidance on input inspection, pricing checks, and API usage through the bundled client interface.
- Improved routing advice for adjacent use cases and clarified what this skill does not handle.
- Updated execution section for strict tool and interface usage.
